subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. 

These types of insects are usually very difficult to __eradicate.__
solution:
"The correct answer is **option 3: conserve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Eradicate** means to completely destroy or get rid of something.
 
• The antonym of **eradicate** would be a word that means to preserve or protect something.
 
• **Conserve **is the most appropriate antonym in the given sentence.
 
• The word "eradicate" means to completely destroy or get rid of something. Therefore, the antonym of "eradicate" would be a word that means to preserve or protect something.
 
• Out of the given options, "conserve" is the most appropriate antonym as it means to protect and preserve something from harm or destruction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Emancipate** means to set free or liberate someone from something.
 
• **Annihilate** means to completely destroy or wipe out something.
 
• **Devastate** means to cause severe damage or destruction to something.
